## Architecture check

Guides applied: [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/ARCHITECTURE.md), [module-structure.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/module-structure.md), [api-dtos-and-validation.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md), [security.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/security.md), [nestjs-patterns.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/nestjs-patterns.md), [best-practices.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/best-practices.md), [caching-and-performance.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/caching-and-performance.md), [database-and-migrations.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/database-and-migrations.md), [configuration-and-flags.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/configuration-and-flags.md), [testing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/testing.md), [commits-and-prs.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md), [reviewing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md), [remarks.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md).

1. **[Cross-module imports via domain only](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/module-structure.md#L73)** — [src/modules/relay/routes/space-relay.controller.ts:44](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/2bdf6ac8d0c100a07c5eda90423466f7d42cad3a/src/modules/relay/routes/space-relay.controller.ts#L44) — the new code reaches into two other modules' `routes/` trees three times (`SpaceIdPipe` here, `Auth` at [line 25](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/2bdf6ac8d0c100a07c5eda90423466f7d42cad3a/src/modules/relay/routes/space-relay.controller.ts#L25), `assertMember` at [space-relay.service.ts:9](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/2bdf6ac8d0c100a07c5eda90423466f7d42cad3a/src/modules/relay/routes/space-relay.service.ts#L9)), while the rule's single exception covers guards only — a pipe, a decorator and a route util stay off limits, which is also AGENTS.md non-negotiable 4. **Fix:** move `space-id.pipe.ts` and `space-assert.utils.ts` under `@/modules/spaces/domain/`, move the `@Auth()` decorator to `src/routes/common/auth/auth.decorator.ts` (the guide's named home for a cross-cutting HTTP-layer artifact), and update the existing importers.
2. **[Splitting a change](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md#L128)** — [src/modules/relay/domain/relay-simulation.service.ts:1](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/2bdf6ac8d0c100a07c5eda90423466f7d42cad3a/src/modules/relay/domain/relay-simulation.service.ts#L1) — three behaviour-preserving extractions (`RelaySimulationService` out of `RelayFeeRelayer`, `resolveTarget` out of `getLimitAddresses`, `safeMatch` out of `addSafes`) ship in the same 30-file diff as the new route and the entitlements event-metering change, the mixed-concern shape [R-029](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md#L435) names. **Fix:** land the three extractions first as `refactor(relay): extract the simulation gate and the relay target resolver`, then the feature on top.
3. **[Swagger completeness](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md#L93)** — [src/modules/relay/routes/space-relay.controller.ts:88](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/2bdf6ac8d0c100a07c5eda90423466f7d42cad3a/src/modules/relay/routes/space-relay.controller.ts#L88) — the handler can answer 501 (`RelayerTypeNotImplementedError` on a `GTF` chain, mapped by `RelayerNotAvailableExceptionFilter`), but no response decorator documents that outcome. **Fix:** add `@ApiResponse({ status: HttpStatus.NOT_IMPLEMENTED, description: 'The chain relayer type is not supported' })` beside the existing response decorators.
4. **[R-006: Asserting that an error was thrown, not which](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md#L128)** — [src/modules/relay/domain/relayers/__tests__/workspace.relayer.spec.ts:350](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/2bdf6ac8d0c100a07c5eda90423466f7d42cad3a/src/modules/relay/domain/relayers/__tests__/workspace.relayer.spec.ts#L350) — the bare `rejects.toThrow()` passes for any rejection, including an unrelated `TypeError` from the line under test. **Fix:** hold the rejection in a const (`const submissionFailed = new Error(faker.lorem.sentence());`), pass it to `mockRelayApi.relay.mockRejectedValue`, and assert `rejects.toThrow(submissionFailed)` as the sibling cases in the same file do.

**Verdict:** ❌ 4 finding(s)
